scenario: Weekly, scan Salesforce leads created in the last 30 days for duplicate email addresses, merge each duplicate set into the oldest record keeping the most recent activity, and post a merge summary to #revops in Slack.
rule_hooks: survivor-record selection rules (oldest created, most complete fields)

scenario: At month end, find HubSpot deals whose close date is more than 60 days past with no logged activity, move them to Closed Lost with reason 'Stale – no response', and email each owner a list of what was closed.

Scan all Salesforce accounts and remap free-text Industry values (e.g. 'Fin Svcs', 'banking', 'FinTech') to the approved picklist using a mapping table in a Google Sheet, flagging unmapped values for review.
rule_hooks: industry mapping table in Google Sheet

scenario: When a sales rep leaves, find all their open leads, contacts, opportunities and tasks in Salesforce and reassign them according to the territory coverage sheet, then notify the receiving reps in Slack.
Daily, find HubSpot quotes past their expiration date that were never signed, mark them Expired, unlink them from open deals, and add a task for the deal owner to reissue if the deal is still active.
rule_hooks: quote validity periods and deal status

scenario: Before the weekly forecast call, scan open Salesforce opportunities with close dates already in the past and push them to the end of the current quarter, logging each change and emailing owners to confirm.
Reconcile the email platform's unsubscribe/bounce list against HubSpot contacts and set Email Opt Out and marketing status on every match, removing them from active sales sequences.
Find Salesforce accounts sharing the same website domain, merge child records into the account with the most closed-won revenue, and log merged account IDs in a Google Sheet audit tab.
Scan HubSpot MQLs older than 45 days that sales never contacted, recycle them to Nurture status, clear the owner, and post counts by source to the marketing Slack channel.
Scan all contacts in HubSpot and reformat phone numbers to E.164 using the contact's country field, flagging records whose numbers can't be parsed.
Read signed DocuSign envelopes for the past year, extract contract end dates, and backfill the Renewal Date field on matching Salesforce accounts where it is empty or mismatched.
rule_hooks: contract term lengths and envelope-to-account matching

scenario: Find open Salesforce follow-up tasks tied to meetings older than 90 days on Closed Lost opportunities, mark them Completed with a cleanup note, and send each owner a digest.
rule_hooks: task age and parent opportunity status

scenario: Scan HubSpot open deals whose probability doesn't match the default for their pipeline stage and reset them to the stage default unless a manager override flag is set.
Quarterly, read current ARR from QuickBooks invoices and re-tag every Salesforce account into Enterprise/Mid-Market/SMB tiers, notifying account managers whose accounts changed tier.
Scan Closed Lost opportunities' free-text 'Lost to' notes and set the structured Competitor picklist using a competitor alias list, leaving 'Other' and a flag for unknown names.
Find Salesforce contacts with no parent account, match them to existing accounts by email domain, link them, and create a review list in Google Sheets for personal-domain emails.
rule_hooks: free-email domain blocklist and domain matching

scenario: Compare last week's calendar demo meetings against Zoom attendance reports, set Meeting Outcome to No-Show on HubSpot meetings where the prospect never joined, and create reschedule tasks for SDRs.
Before forecast lock, scan open opportunities in Commit or Best Case lacking next step, amount, or decision maker, and post a per-rep list in Slack while setting a Data Incomplete flag.
Find DocuSign envelopes sent more than 30 days ago that are still unsigned, void them, set the linked Salesforce opportunity's contract status to Voided, and notify the deal owner.

Scan HubSpot contacts and assign the Buyer Persona property (Economic Buyer, Champion, Technical Evaluator, User) from job titles using a keyword rules sheet, overwriting only blank or 'Unknown' personas.
Reconcile last quarter's Closed Won Salesforce opportunities against Xero invoices, flagging deals with no invoice or amount mismatches beyond 2% and updating a Billing Status field on each.
rule_hooks: amount tolerance and invoice matching keys

scenario: Scan leads with Lead Source blank or 'Other', derive the source from UTM parameters stored on the original form submission, and update the field using the UTM-to-source mapping.
Find partner-registered opportunities whose 90-day registration window has lapsed without progressing past Discovery, remove the partner protection flag, and email the partner manager a list.
rule_hooks: deal registration window and stage rules

scenario: Read a corporate family reference spreadsheet and set the Parent Account on Salesforce subsidiaries that are missing it or point to the wrong parent, logging every change.
Compare cancelled subscriptions in the billing system with Salesforce accounts still marked Customer, change them to Former Customer, close their open renewal opportunities, and alert CS in Slack.
Scan Gmail for hard-bounce notifications from sales outreach in the past two weeks, mark the corresponding HubSpot contacts' email as invalid, and pull them out of active sequences.
After a price book update, scan open opportunities with line items still at old list prices and update them to the new price book, skipping deals with approved custom discounts.
rule_hooks: current price book and discount approval flags

scenario: Find contacts enrolled in prospecting sequences whose company is now a paying customer, unenroll them, and notify the account manager so they aren't cold-emailed.
rule_hooks: customer status and sequence exclusion rules

scenario: At the start of the fiscal year, reassign every account to its new territory and owner based on billing state and employee count from the new territory plan sheet, emailing each rep their new book.
rule_hooks: territory plan by geography and segment

scenario: Scan Zendesk for accounts with three or more open high-priority tickets and set an 'At Risk – Support' flag on matching Salesforce accounts and their open renewal opportunities, clearing the flag on accounts that no longer qualify.
Find accounts with multiple open opportunities of the same type and product family, keep the most advanced one, close the others as Duplicate, and notify the owners involved.
rule_hooks: duplicate definition by type, product and stage

scenario: Find EU contacts with no engagement and no open deal for 24 months, anonymize their personal fields in HubSpot per the retention policy, and log the purged IDs in a compliance sheet.
Scan open opportunities above $50k that lack contact roles, attach contacts from the account who attended Zoom or calendar meetings on the deal, and assign roles based on title rules.
rule_hooks: deal size threshold and title-to-role rules

scenario: Find customer accounts with contracts ending in the next 120 days that have no open renewal opportunity, create one at current ARR with the correct close date, and assign it to the account manager.
rule_hooks: renewal lead time and ARR source

scenario: Scan sales reps' Google Calendar events with external attendees from last week that are not logged in Salesforce, create matching activity records on the right contacts and opportunities, and list unmatched meetings for review.
Scan quotes created this quarter with discounts above the rep's authority level and no approval record, set them back to Draft, and post the list to the deal desk Slack channel.
Scan Salesforce account billing addresses and normalize country and state values to ISO codes, correcting common misspellings and flagging addresses that don't validate.
Find leads and contacts in HubSpot owned by deactivated users, round-robin them among the active SDR pool by region, and post the redistribution counts to Slack.
rule_hooks: active SDR roster and round-robin by region

scenario: Compare Closed Won deals from the past month against onboarding projects in Asana, create missing kickoff projects from the template, and set the Handoff Complete checkbox on the deals.
rule_hooks: handoff checklist and project template by product

scenario: Scan open opportunities where forecast category conflicts with stage (e.g. Commit in Prospecting), reset forecast category to the stage default, and email each manager a list of overridden deals.

Weekly, RevOps scans HubSpot contacts still at lifecycle stage Lead or SQL whose associated company has a closed-won deal, and advances them to Customer so marketing stops sending them prospect nurture emails.
Before month-end, finance ops finds open QuickBooks estimates whose lines have no sales tax code, sets the code based on the customer's ship-to state, and flags out-of-nexus states to the deal owner.

Salesforce leads moved to Disqualified this quarter without a Disqualification Reason get a picklist value inferred from the rep's last logged note or email (no budget, wrong fit, competitor, no response).

Open opportunities whose currency doesn't match the account's billing country (e.g., a USD deal for a German account) are corrected and their amounts reconverted, except where the contract specifies a currency override.
Slack #deal-* rooms tied to opportunities that closed won or lost more than 30 days ago are archived after a final summary message with the outcome and the CRM link is posted.

After a product retirement, open opportunities and draft quotes that still contain discontinued SKUs have them replaced with the successor SKU from product management's mapping sheet, and each owner is notified of the price delta.
HubSpot deals created in the New Business pipeline for companies that already have an active subscription are moved to the Expansion pipeline at the equivalent stage, and the deal type is relabeled.
Legal ops' NDA tracker sheet is reconciled against DocuSign completion dates. Rows past their term are marked Expired, and AEs with open opportunities on those accounts are emailed to renew.

The sales comp team compares the commission workbook against closed-won opportunity team splits for the quarter, fixes rows whose split percentages or rep names disagree with the CRM, and lists unresolved discrepancies for the comp manager.
rule_hooks: opportunity split percentages, comp plan rules

scenario: Leads whose product trial end date has passed with no purchase and no open opportunity are moved from Trialing to Nurture status, and their pending SDR tasks are closed.
Open opportunities whose names don't follow the 'Account - Product - Type - FYQ' convention are renamed using the account name, primary product line, deal type, and close-date fiscal quarter.
Account website fields containing tracking parameters, 'www', page paths, or broken URLs are normalized to the bare root domain, and accounts that end up sharing a domain are flagged for review.

After a Zoom webinar, the attendee report is compared with Salesforce campaign members. Registrants who attended become Attended, no-shows become No Show, and attendees who are missing from the campaign are added.
rule_hooks: attendance duration threshold, campaign status values

scenario: Accounts with Xero invoices more than 60 days overdue get a Credit Hold flag on the CRM account, which blocks new quotes, and their AEs get a Slack message. Accounts that have since paid in full have the flag cleared.

Intercom conversations from the past week tagged 'pricing' or 'demo request' whose senders aren't in the CRM are turned into leads with the conversation linked, and existing contacts get the conversation logged on their open opportunity.

Zendesk organizations with no CRM Account ID in their external ID field are matched to Salesforce accounts by email domain and the ID is backfilled. Ambiguous or unmatched organizations go into a review sheet.
Next quarter's renewal opportunities still priced at the prior-year amount are updated with the contractual price uplift from each contract's escalator clause, capped at the negotiated maximum.

Closed-won and late-stage opportunities with a contract term over 12 months where ACV equals TCV have ACV recalculated as TCV divided by term years, so the pipeline and bookings reports stop overstating annual value.
Untouched inbound leads older than 48 hours are taken from overloaded SDRs and redistributed round-robin to SDRs in the same region who are under their open-lead capacity cap.
Contacts and leads whose phone numbers appear on the internal do-not-call list or the latest national DNC extract get Do Not Call checked, and any open call tasks on them are cancelled.

Inbound leads that used a free webmail address (gmail, yahoo, outlook) and have no company domain match are moved to a low-priority queue and tagged 'Freemail', unless their lead score is above the hot threshold.
Accounts typed Prospect that hold an active contract are changed to Customer, and accounts typed Customer with no active contract or won deals are changed to Former Customer or Prospect.

Open opportunities past stage 2 whose Next Step field is blank or whose next-step date is more than 7 days past get a follow-up task for the owner, and each manager is sent a digest of their team's affected deals.

Completed DocuSign envelopes from the past month whose signed PDF isn't attached to the related opportunity, or whose CRM contract is still in Draft, get the document attached and the contract activated with its signed date.

Contacts synced between HubSpot and Salesforce that have different owners in the two systems are realigned to the Salesforce owner, which is the system of record, except for contacts still in marketing-owned lifecycle stages.
Leads still marked 'Open - Not Contacted' that have a booked discovery meeting on the SDR team calendar are advanced to 'Working - Meeting Set', and the meeting date is recorded.

Opportunities with several quote versions keep only the latest synced primary quote active. Older drafts and presented versions are marked Superseded so that reps and CPQ approvals stop referencing stale pricing.

The sales leadership target-account sheet for the new fiscal year is reconciled against the CRM's Named Account flag. Flags are added or removed to match the sheet, and named accounts without an assigned strategic AE are reported.

Asana proof-of-concept projects are compared with opportunities in the Pilot stage. POC projects for lost deals are closed, and opportunities are updated with pilot end dates and success-criteria status from Asana.

Recent Gmail auto-replies to sales outreach saying the recipient has left the company are used to mark the matching contacts 'No Longer at Company'. The named replacement is added as a new contact on the same account.

Free-text loss reasons on the year's closed-lost opportunities are mapped to the standard Loss Reason picklist (price, timing, competitor, no decision, product gap) so the win/loss report becomes usable.
Opportunities in Proposal stage or later with a $0 or blank amount have the amount filled in from their primary quote total. Owners of those with no quote are asked to provide one.

Quota values on CRM forecast records for each rep and quarter are compared with finance's approved quota spreadsheet, corrected where they differ, and created for newly hired reps who don't have them yet.

Leads created from web forms with test or gibberish values (names like 'test' or 'asdf', example.com emails, phone 555-5555) are deleted or archived after a check that none are linked to activities or campaigns.

The support plan tier on Freshdesk companies is aligned to the support SKU on each customer's active CRM contract (Standard, Premium, Enterprise), and accounts that were downgraded or upgraded are flagged to their CSM.

Child accounts under a named enterprise parent whose owner differs from the parent's owner are reassigned to the parent owner per the global account policy. Carve-outs listed for international subsidiaries are left alone.
rule_hooks: global account ownership policy, carve-out list

scenario: Customer accounts with zero or multiple contacts marked Primary are fixed. The primary is chosen by contract signer, then most recent opportunity contact role, and the account owner is notified when there is no candidate.

Leads that have sat in Qualified status for more than 14 days without being converted are converted into contact, account, and opportunity when they match conversion criteria. The rest are returned to the SDR with a reminder.

Customers flagged tax-exempt in QuickBooks whose exemption certificate expiry in the certificate tracker sheet has passed have the exempt flag removed. Their AEs and the billing contacts are emailed to request a renewed certificate.

Customer billing emails in QuickBooks are compared with the Billing Contact role on the CRM account. Mismatched or bounced QuickBooks emails are updated to the CRM billing contact, and accounts with no billing contact are flagged.
